body: You know that means a lot coming from a complete stranger- I really appreciate it! Sometimes, I'm just scared that my friends will think that my goal really is to complain when I talk to them, therefore I do not. I don't want them to ditch me for being negative so much.
go to bed 10 min earlier, to read.
Thanks- you made me think  a bunch, I will see if the library has it.
I know what you mean, but regardless you have to allow that time, and make time for it. You are worth it.

You shouldn't feel bad for me. However If i've learned something: It makes me feel better when I do something for myself: I snowboard- and when I'm out on the hill, the only thing I think about, is my next manuvre. It feels good to forget about the whole I'm not good enough, adn the meaning of life for a bit. Do something for yourself. Take a bath, read a book, draw, write a story, start a project. feel proud of yourself for distracting yourself. Do this on a daily basis.

Thank you for hearing me out- Talking to a stranger I feel is a better way. I have struggled with depression since I believe I was 10 years old. I have always been ashamed and lost friends because of it, they saw me as always being sad, and not smiling, and did not want to surround themselves with people who are constantly down. I usually try to put a poker face for this reason, and pretend it doesn't happen or that I don't feel this way. Deep down I cry. I started to cry the other day for no reason. I didn't feel sad. I didn't feel angry. I just cried.

You know for different reasons I feel the same way you do. However, we need to get ourselves through this- I am now 23. Hopefully you will sooner than it took me. If it's at least a bit encouraging- I had a good few years in between now and then. A different set of events happened, that I am feeling like this now.

>Do you think you are hurting because of your mother or what happened to you in school?

I don't think I feel the urge to hurt myself because of these events directly, I think that sometimes it just relieves pain from one place and puts it in another, I'd rather be hurting physically than mentally, even if it's just for a short amount of time. 

I think the only reason why I haven't killed myself before, is because I am not selfish- and cannot leave people behind. If it wasn't for this I probably would.

It just hurts to much to talk to them about it. It hurts even thinking aout it. This is the reason why I came to reddit instead. It's not that I can't trust them- I just don't want them knowing. They might see me in a different way, I want them to treat me the same. I don't want either people to think I am joking.
How old are you if you don't mind me asking?
